articles.title: More private credit loans for sale than ever, but secondary demand appears tepid
articles.mainIdea: More private credit loans for sale than ever, but secondary demand appears tepid
articles.summary: Pitchbook: More private credit loans for sale than ever, but secondary demand appears tepid. More private credit loans are up for sale than ever before on a nascent secondary market, driven by elevated investor redemptions in BDCs that are pushing credit managers to seek ways of boosting liquidity in a skittish market. However, the elevated inventory of loans for sale does not necessarily mean that secondary trading has increased significantly, market participants say. Instead, the supply of loans is outpacing demand for them, and aftermarket liquidity for private credit loans is thin. Related tickers mentioned: JEF, JPM, MS.
